declaration.selection: five latest complete modelled dates from previous consumed-day study, fixed before new results
declaration.population: all 288 venue-resolved markets/day; every arm starts flat per market; same pre-60s policy
declaration.keep_queue: after 60s, preserve same-price guard-eligible current order despite size changes only when its known remainder plus all other reducing reservations fits known inventory; combined also limits remainder to 5
declaration.small_reduce: after 60s, cap the original reduce-only desired size at 5 shares; no new no-flip guarantee
declaration.urgent_quote: 180<=t<240 and abs(known net)>=10: improve reducing quote by one 1-cent tick if strictly passive; original quote must pass all original guards
declaration.urgency_cost: Deliberately spends 1 cent/share for faster reduction. Original model score is not claimed calibrated to improved price; full price cost enters actual fill PnL.

stress.scope: one-day uniform completed-cancel p99 reservation sensitivity; no interval or calibrated live OMS claim

null.design: paired UTC-day sign flips; shared flips across arms, metrics and J/X; sign-invariant scaling
null.family: 4 candidates x 2 timings x 2 metrics (settlement and +1s) = 16; all other metrics descriptive

controls: disabled adapter exact baseline parity with previous study
pre-60s fills and requests exact between all arms in every window
synthetic queue/partial-fill/reservation/size/price engagement and known-bad refusal
day-null signal positive control and invalid population refusal
limitations: fixed guard trained on four of these five days; exploratory in-sample comparison
all dates already consumed; no untouched validation or new strategy selection
historical tape has no own market impact or full OMS/watchdog replay
known-state order reservations retained; fills can still cross zero before knowledge/cancel catches up
post-fill diagnostics are attribution, not an outcome-selected learning or causal-fill comparison
no quoting beyond 240s: frozen guard coverage ends there
declaration.execution_reuse: Unchanged baseline is freshly replayed on Oct27 at J/X (and Oct31 J already running); remaining main baseline artifacts are reused from prior verified study, with hashes/origin explicit. Stress baseline always fresh. All candidates still full independent replays; no treatment parameters or population changes.
declaration.small_order_minimum: Five-share cap can withhold a new order below the existing 1-USDT minimum; report MIN_USD statuses rather than assuming a five-share order always executable.
declaration.fill_identity_correction: Checker refused duplicate create timestamps on Oct31 X. Policy/PnL unchanged. Report bounds on distinct filled orders: immutable price/size gives lower count; sent requests and fill tranches bound upper count; accepted-order total remains exact. Identification bounds are not confidence intervals. Recheck completed artifacts without rerunning strategies.

interpretation: consumed-day in-sample policy feasibility; no live-return, untouched-validation or full OMS parity claim
inventory_statistics: economic path from each fill; known net at 60s uses fixed 100ms fill knowledge delay; entry is shared before interventions
fill_statistics: accepted orders = place attempts minus post-only rejections; filled-generation identification bounds use market/lane/activation plus immutable price/size; conditional fill ages are descriptive
inference_limit: five complete UTC days; wide intervals and coarse sign-flip inference; no intervals for one-day stress
